steps.title: Add your place
steps.body: Your address and up to ten favourite spots. Five minutes, once.

steps.title: Send the link
steps.body: Every guest gets their own link or QR code. No app, no sign-up.

steps.title: Your guest gets their city
steps.body: Three quick taste questions, then places, a playlist, a film shelf and a concierge built around them.

different.title: Why it's different
different.body: Ask an AI chatbot alone for restaurants and every guest gets much the same famous names, and some aren't near the flat at all. Host Brain asks Qloo's taste graph what people who love the same music and films actually go to. The language model only explains and talks.
different.aiAloneLine: One list for everyone, nobody checks it.
different.withQlooLine: Picks matched to each guest's taste, every one a real place nearby.

hotels.title: For hotels
hotels.body: Put a QR code in every room. Guests scan it, answer three quick questions and get a guide of their own, with no time at the front desk.
points: First name optional, nothing else asked
